photo.alt: View over the city from an upper floor

facts: About 1.8 million people in the city proper (2024 census)
1,190 m up, on the Buganda hills
worth_knowing: The name comes from "Hill of the Impala": British officials were given a hill that had been a hunting reserve of the Kabaka of Buganda, with many impala. Akasozi k'empala was shortened to Kampala.
